title: roettlera obtusa
intro: Roettlera obtusa, commonly known as the Chinese angelica, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. Roettlera obtusa has been found to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Roettlera obtusa include flavonoids, terpenoids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
